The '''Cleansing of Nopsin''' was a military operation carried out by the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] commanded by the [[General/Legends|General]] [[Greist]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenants]] [[Pierce]] and [[Phenter]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nopsin]] sometime during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
